display.purpose: Playfair Display for profile name and modal headlines.

body.purpose: UI and system font for reading copy and controls.

narrative.overview: Pintrest AI presents itself as a curated visual culture publication — Monocle, Kinfolk, and art catalogue sensibilities brought to a real-time web application. The ground is a warm editorial cream (#faf8f4), hairlines dividers (#e2ddd7) provide structural poise without heavy borders, and titles are typeset in Playfair Display. The Pinterest red (#e60023) is preserved strictly as the primary commitment signal: the Save button and Log In CTA.
keyCharacteristics: Warm cream background (#faf8f4) with warm ink type (#1a1816)
Playfair Display serif for headlines and pin captions; clean system sans for UI copy
1px hairline dividers (#e2ddd7) replacing heavy grey outlines
Pill-shaped controls and 16px rounded card corners
Action red (#e60023) reserved exclusively for user commitment

rules.name: The One Red Rule
rules.body: #e60023 appears on only the active commitment elements (Save, Log In, Liked heart).

rules.name: The Editorial Ground Rule
rules.body: The background is always warm cream (#faf8f4), never pure clinical #ffffff or grey #f4f4f5.

dos: Do use Playfair Display for captions and headers.
Do use border-radius: var(--radius-pill) on interactive controls.
donts: Don't add heavy drop shadows at rest.
Don't use cold clinical blue-greys on backgrounds.
Don't use gradient text or decorative banners.
